uncited: **Inputs:** A 3D volume dataset $V$, a set of $p$ processors, and a camera viewpoint.
The volume $V$ is partitioned into $p$ disjoint subvolumes $V_1, V_2, \dots, V_p$.
Each processor $i$ stores $V_i$ in its local memory.
*   *Note:* Because a single ray may traverse multiple subvolumes assigned to different processors, the accumulation of optical properties (color and opacity) is distributed.
This step resolves the depth ordering of fragments generated from different subvolumes.
*   **Time:** $O(N/p)$ for rendering per processor, where $N$ is the total number of voxels/ray steps, plus $O(C)$ for compositing, where $C$ is the cost of communication/compositing.
